title: Numbers on the Board
statement: The task is to erase as few of the integers l..r (-100 <= l <= r <= 100, 10^4 tests) as possible so that some remaining number equals the sum of all remaining numbers. The others must then form a zero-sum subset, largest when it is the pairs +/-1..+/-min(-l, r) plus zero, so the answer is an O(1) closed-form math formula by casework on the signs of l and r.
